title: Why Focusing On Winning Will Actually Destroy You 🛑 #shorts
description:
Speaker reveals how legendary cycling coach Sir Dave Brailsford banned Olympic champion Christopher Hoy from thinking about the podium or records. By forcing athletes to obsess exclusively over the pedals instead of the outcome, their performance skyrocketed. ⚡
